# Free Crypto News (cryptocurrency.cv)

> Free, real-time cryptocurrency news and market intelligence API aggregating 300+ sources. No API key required for the core news, search, feed and market endpoints; premium and high-cost endpoints accept USDC micropayments via x402. REST JSON, RSS/Atom feeds, WebSocket/SSE streaming, AI analysis, historical archive, MCP server, ChatGPT plugin.
> Source-available, all rights reserved; the hosted API is free to use. See LICENSE. https://cryptocurrency.cv

Free Crypto News is a project by [nirholas](https://github.com/nirholas) deployed at https://cryptocurrency.cv. It aggregates crypto news from CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, CoinTelegraph, Bitcoin Magazine, Blockworks, The Defiant, and 300+ additional sources. Core endpoints are free, unauthenticated, and CORS-enabled.

## Free Endpoints (no key)

- [Latest news](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/news): `GET /api/news` — latest articles from all sources (limit, source, page, category, lang params)
- [Search](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/search): `GET /api/search?q={keywords}` — full-text search across all sources
- [Bitcoin news](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/bitcoin): `GET /api/bitcoin` — Bitcoin-specific articles
- [DeFi news](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/defi): `GET /api/defi` — DeFi, yield farming, DEX news
- [Breaking news](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/breaking): `GET /api/breaking` — articles from last 2 hours
- [Trending topics](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/trending): `GET /api/trending` — trending keywords and topics
- [Sources list](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/sources): `GET /api/sources` — all sources with status
- [Sentiment](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/sentiment): `GET /api/sentiment` — AI-powered sentiment analysis
- [Market data](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/market): `GET /api/market` — prices and market context
- [Fear & Greed](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/fear-greed): `GET /api/fear-greed` — crypto fear & greed index
- [Archive](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/archive): `GET /api/archive?date=2024-01|ticker=BTC|q=...` — historical archive
- [RSS feed](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/rss): `GET /api/rss` — RSS 2.0 feed of latest news
- [Atom feed](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/atom): `GET /api/atom` — Atom feed of latest news

## AI & LLM Features

- [AI analysis](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/ai): `GET /api/ai` — summarize, sentiment, facts, fact-check, translate articles
- [Ask](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/ask): `GET /api/ask?q={question}` — ask natural language questions about crypto news
- [Narratives](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/ai/narratives): emerging market narratives detection
- [Predictions](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/predictions): AI-generated price and event predictions
- [Research](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/ai/research): deep research mode on topics
- [RAG](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/rag): retrieval-augmented generation over news archive
- [MCP server (hosted)](https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http crypto-news https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/mcp`
- [MCP server (local)](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/mcp): stdio server; clone the repo, then `cd mcp && npm install && node index.js`
- [ChatGPT plugin](https://cryptocurrency.cv/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): OpenAI plugin manifest

## Payment (x402) for premium and metered endpoints

Premium and high-cost endpoints (`/api/premium/*`, `/api/v1/*` metered variants) accept x402 USDC micropayments, $0.001–$0.20 per request, with no signup.

```javascript
import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "@x402/fetch";
const payFetch = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, wallet);
const res = await payFetch("https://cryptocurrency.cv/api/v1/news");
```

Or install the agentcash MCP server: `npx agentcash install`

Network: Arbitrum (eip155:42161) | Asset: USDC | Default price: $0.001

## Key Metered Endpoints

### News & Content
- `GET /api/v1/news` — latest articles from 300+ sources ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/breaking` — breaking news ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/bitcoin` — Bitcoin-specific news ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/categories` — news categories ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/sources` — all sources with status ($0.001)

### Market Data
- `GET /api/v1/coins` — top coins with prices and market cap ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/market-data` — global market overview ($0.002)
- `GET /api/v1/trending` — trending coins ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/fear-greed` — Fear & Greed Index ($0.002)
- `GET /api/market/gainers` — biggest gainers ($0.001)
- `GET /api/market/losers` — biggest losers ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/exchanges` — exchange data ($0.002)

### AI Analysis
- `GET /api/v1/sentiment?asset=BTC` — AI sentiment ($0.005)
- `GET /api/v1/ask?q={question}` — ask anything about crypto ($0.005)
- `GET /api/v1/forecast?coinId=bitcoin` — AI price forecast ($0.005)
- `GET /api/v1/digest` — daily market digest ($0.005)
- `GET /api/v1/narratives` — emerging narratives ($0.005)
- `GET /api/ai/research?topic={topic}` — deep research ($0.01)

### DeFi & On-Chain
- `GET /api/defi` — DeFi protocol overview ($0.001)
- `GET /api/defi/yields` — yield opportunities ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/dex` — DEX volumes ($0.002)
- `GET /api/v1/whale-alerts` — large transactions ($0.003)
- `GET /api/onchain/exchange-flows` — exchange flows ($0.001)

### Derivatives & Trading
- `GET /api/derivatives` — futures/options overview ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/signals` — AI trading signals ($0.005)
- `GET /api/v1/liquidations` — liquidation data ($0.003)
- `GET /api/funding-rates` — perpetual funding rates ($0.001)
- `GET /api/v1/arbitrage` — arbitrage opportunities ($0.003)

### Multi-Chain
- `GET /api/solana/*` — Solana tokens, DeFi, NFTs, wallet data
- `GET /api/bitcoin/*` — blocks, mempool, difficulty, addresses
- `GET /api/aptos/*` — Aptos transactions, resources, events
- `GET /api/sui/*` — Sui balances, objects, transactions
- `GET /api/l2/*` — Layer 2 activity, projects, risk scores

### Social Intelligence
- `GET /api/social/sentiment` — social media sentiment ($0.001)
- `GET /api/social/trending-narratives` — trending narratives ($0.001)
- `GET /api/social/x/sentiment` — X/Twitter crypto sentiment ($0.001)
- `GET /api/influencers` — crypto influencer data ($0.001)

### Premium ($0.01–$0.20)
- `GET /api/premium/ai/signals` — AI trading signals ($0.05)
- `GET /api/premium/ai/analyze` — deep market analysis ($0.05)
- `GET /api/premium/whales/transactions` — whale tracking ($0.05)
- `GET /api/premium/smart-money` — institutional flows ($0.05)
- `GET /api/premium/stream/prices` — real-time price SSE ($0.05)
- `GET /api/premium/pass/hour` — 1hr unlimited access ($0.25)

## SDKs & Tools

- [TypeScript/JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/sdk/typescript): `npm install @nirholas/crypto-news`
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/sdk/python): install from the repository (`pip install ./sdk/python`)
- [React hooks](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/sdk/react): `useCryptoNews()` React hook
- [CLI tool](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/cli): command-line interface (`cd cli && npm install && node index.js`)
- [Embeddable widget](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/widget): drop-in HTML widget
- [VS Code Copilot extension](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv/tree/main/copilot-extension): GitHub Copilot integration
- **x402**: `@x402/fetch` (npm), `x402-client` (Python)
